text:
Marcus & Millichap (NYSE: MMI), a leading commercial real estate brokerage firm specializing in investment sales, financing, research and advisory services, announced today the sale of 4742 Sepulveda Blvd., a 21-unit multifamily property in Sherman Oaks, California.. The property sold for $6.98 million, or $332,380 per unit.
“Newer construction multifamily assets with minimal near-term capital requirements remain highly sought after in the San Fernando Valley,” said Sam Liberow, senior managing director investments. “The property generated multiple offers from investors who recognize today’s pricing environment as an opportunity to acquire quality Los Angeles real estate at values not seen in more than a decade.”
Liberow, in Marcus & Millichap’s Encino office, had the exclusive listing to market the property on behalf of the seller, Southview Investment Company, and procured the buyer, Xenon Investments.
Built in 2014, the 28,150-square-foot property is situated on a 0.37-acre parcel at 4742 Sepulveda Blvd. in Sherman Oaks. The property consists of 21 units, including 19 two-bedroom, two-bath units and two studio units. Apartment interiors feature stainless steel appliances, granite countertops, in-unit washers and dryers, wood and tile flooring, and private balconies in the two-bedroom units. Located just north of Ventura Boulevard, the property offers immediate access to premier shopping, dining, grocery stores and entertainment, as well as convenient access to the U.S. Route 101 and Interstate 405 freeways.
Marcus & Millichap, Inc. is a leading brokerage firm specializing in commercial real estate investment sales, financing, research and advisory services with offices throughout the United States and Canada. Marcus & Millichap closed 8,818 transactions with a sales volume of $50.8 billion in 2025. The company had 1,808 investment sales and financing professionals in more than 80 offices who provide investment brokerage and financing services to sellers and buyers of commercial real estate at year end.
